files.text:
' ROCKS - NTC3D's example game: fly through a field of drifting rocks and shoot them, a beacon
' going round, drones swaying through and the odd hunter that turns after you and shoots back.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
' Keys: S / X dive and climb, N / M roll, Space / V faster and slower, A or Enter fire.
' All the moving, the hits and the drawing are the framework's (Obj3D, Fly3D, Hud3D, E3): this is
' only what's what and what a hit does - the whole game is BASIC.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo
Option NexData "ROCKS.DAT", 1

Const K_FIRE = 64
Const C_HUD = 13 * 16 + 13, C_DIM = 13 * 16 + 7, C_RED = 2 * 16 + 11, C_GOLD = 6 * 16 + 14
Const C_CYAN = 7 * 16 + 13
Const T_ROCK = 1, T_BEACON = 2, T_DRONE = 3, T_HUNTER = 4, T_BOLT = 5

Dim keys As Integer, dt As Integer, vflip As Integer, frames As Integer
Dim score As Integer, shown As Integer, shield As Integer, cool As Integer, stm As Integer
Dim e As Integer, i As Integer, s As Integer, k As Integer, txerr As Integer

E3.Init
E3.nstar = 32                            ' (half the stars: they cost)
Obj3D.Init
Fly3D.Init
Obj3D.BoltModel E3Data.K_BOLT, 1, 12 * 16 + 14
Obj3D.DebrisModel E3Data.K_SHARD, 2, 3 * 16 + 10, 1     ' (its bits fall a little)
Obj3D.BlastModel E3Data.K_FIREBALL, 3 * 16 + 14
Obj3D.blife = 70
Hud3D.Ink 1, C_DIM : Hud3D.Ink 2, C_HUD : Hud3D.Ink 3, C_GOLD : Hud3D.Ink 4, C_RED
Do
  NewGame
  Do
    keys = ReadKeys()
    Fly3D.Steer keys, dt
    k = Fly3D.Rebase()
    Spawner
    If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - dt
    If (keys And K_FIRE) And cool <= 0 Then
      s = Obj3D.Fire(-1, 220)
      If s >= 0 Then Obj3D.otype(s) = T_BOLT
      cool = 8
    End If
    Obj3D.Update dt
    Events
    E3.Begin 0
    E3.Stars
    Obj3D.Draw
    Hud
    Sync
  Loop While shield > 0
  GameOver
Loop

' NewGame: the field, you in the middle of it
Sub NewGame()
  Obj3D.Clear
  E3.CamReset
  E3.CamPos 0, 0, 0
  Fly3D.Init
  Fly3D.spd = 1200 : Fly3D.smax = 2600
  score = 0 : shown = -1 : shield = 100 : stm = 0
  For k = 1 To 8
    Rock
  Next
  ' the beacon: round the middle, 6000 out, 10 256ths of a turn a second
  s = Obj3D.Spawn(E3Data.K_BEACON, 3, Obj3D.CL_SCENERY, 6000, 800, 0, C_GOLD)
  Obj3D.SetMover s, Obj3D.MV_ORBIT, 0
  Obj3D.opa(s) = 0 : Obj3D.opb(s) = 0 : Obj3D.odist(s) = 6000 : Obj3D.ospd(s) = 10
  Obj3D.otype(s) = T_BEACON : Obj3D.ouv(s) = 3 : Obj3D.Spin s, 6, 0 : Obj3D.Mark s, C_GOLD
  Hud3D.Wipe
  Hud3D.Text 4, 1, "SCORE", 1
  Hud3D.Text 4, 184, "SHIELD", 1
  Hud3D.Cross 128, 96, 2
End Sub

' Rock: a rock somewhere ahead of you, drifting, turning; put back ahead when you leave it behind
Sub Rock()
  s = Obj3D.Spawn(E3Data.K_ROCKA + Rnd(2), 3, Obj3D.CL_ENEMY, Fly3D.cx + Rnd(16000) - 8000, Fly3D.cy + Rnd(8000) - 4000, Fly3D.cz + 4000 + Rnd(9000), 6)
  If s < 0 Then Exit Sub
  Obj3D.SetMover s, Obj3D.MV_STRAIGHT, Obj3D.OF_WRAP
  Obj3D.SetVel s, Rnd(31) - 15, Rnd(21) - 10, Rnd(31) - 15
  Obj3D.opa(s) = Rnd(6000) - 3000 : Obj3D.opb(s) = Rnd(4000) - 2000
  Obj3D.Spin s, Rnd(5) - 2, Rnd(3) + 1
  Obj3D.omask(s) = Obj3D.M_PLAYER : Obj3D.otype(s) = T_ROCK : Obj3D.ouv(s) = 2
  Obj3D.Mark s, C_RED
End Sub

' Spawner: rocks kept up to 8, now and then a drone or a hunter
Sub Spawner()
  stm = stm - dt
  If stm > 0 Then Exit Sub
  stm = 100
  If Obj3D.Count(Obj3D.CL_ENEMY) < 10 Then Rock
  k = Rnd(3)
  If k = 0 Then
    ' a drone: swaying its way across ahead of you
    s = Obj3D.Spawn(E3Data.K_DRONE, 2, Obj3D.CL_ENEMY, Fly3D.cx - 5000, Fly3D.cy, Fly3D.cz + 7000, 4 * 16 + 10)
    If s >= 0 Then
      Obj3D.SetMover s, Obj3D.MV_WEAVE, Obj3D.OF_FACEVEL + Obj3D.OF_WRAP
      Obj3D.SetVel s, 50, 0, 0 : Obj3D.opa(s) = 30 : Obj3D.opb(s) = 20
      Obj3D.omask(s) = Obj3D.M_PLAYER : Obj3D.otype(s) = T_DRONE : Obj3D.ouv(s) = 1 : Obj3D.Mark s, C_HUD
    End If
  ElseIf k = 1 Then
    ' a hunter: turns after you, shoots now and then
    s = Obj3D.Spawn(E3Data.K_HUNTER, 2, Obj3D.CL_ENEMY, Fly3D.cx + Rnd(4000) - 2000, Fly3D.cy + 2000, Fly3D.cz + 9000, 2 * 16 + 10)
    If s >= 0 Then
      Obj3D.SetMover s, Obj3D.MV_TURN, Obj3D.OF_FACECAM + Obj3D.OF_WRAP
      Obj3D.ospd(s) = 60 : Obj3D.ogun(s) = 60 : Obj3D.odist(s) = 2500   ' (it sits 2500 ahead of you)
      Obj3D.omask(s) = Obj3D.M_PLAYER : Obj3D.otype(s) = T_HUNTER : Obj3D.ouv(s) = 2 : Obj3D.Mark s, C_RED
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' Events: what Obj3D.Update found
Sub Events()
  Do
    e = Obj3D.NextEvent()
    If e = 0 Then Exit Do
    i = Obj3D.ea
    If e = Obj3D.EV_FIRE Then
      ' a hunter's gun is ready: a bolt at you, and again in a while
      s = Obj3D.Fire(i, 140)
      If s >= 0 Then Obj3D.otype(s) = T_BOLT
      Obj3D.ogun(i) = 80 + Rnd(60)
    ElseIf Obj3D.eb = 255 Then
      ' it hit you
      shield = shield - 15
      If Obj3D.otype(i) = T_BOLT Then
        Obj3D.Kill i
      Else
        Blast i
      End If
    ElseIf Obj3D.ocls(i) = Obj3D.CL_PBOLT Then
      ' your bolt hit something (still there: it may have gone up already this frame)
      s = Obj3D.eb
      If Obj3D.ocls(s) = Obj3D.CL_ENEMY Or Obj3D.ocls(s) = Obj3D.CL_SCENERY Then
        Obj3D.Kill i
        Obj3D.ouv(s) = Obj3D.ouv(s) - 1
        If Obj3D.ouv(s) <= 0 Then
          Select Case Obj3D.otype(s)
            Case T_ROCK: score = score + 10
            Case T_DRONE: score = score + 25
            Case T_HUNTER: score = score + 50
            Case T_BEACON: score = score + 100
          End Select
          Blast s
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Loop
End Sub

' Blast i: it blows up - bits flying, a fireball
Sub Blast(ByVal i As Integer)
  Obj3D.Pos i
  Obj3D.Burst Obj3D.px, Obj3D.py, Obj3D.pz, 4, Obj3D.ovx(i), Obj3D.ovy(i), Obj3D.ovz(i)
  Obj3D.Boom i, 3
End Sub

' Hud: the score (on the ULA, when it changes), the shield bar, the scanner
Sub Hud()
  If score <> shown Then
    Hud3D.Num 40, 1, score, 5, 2
    shown = score
  End If
  Hud3D.Bar 44, 182, 62, 8, shield, 100, C_HUD, C_DIM - 5
  Hud3D.Scanner 109, 165, 38, 26, C_DIM - 3, 0
End Sub

' GameOver: the shield's gone - a word, then again
Sub GameOver()
  Dim t As Integer
  Hud3D.Text 101, 92, "GAME OVER", 4
  t = 0
  Do While t < 150
    E3.Begin 0
    E3.Stars
    Obj3D.Update dt
    Obj3D.Draw
    Sync
    t = t + dt
  Loop
End Sub

' ReadKeys(): the controls as Fly3D's bits, K_FIRE for fire
Function ReadKeys() As Integer
  Dim r As Integer
  k = 0
  r = Inp(&HFDFE)                          ' A S D F G
  If (r And 1) = 0 Then k = k Or K_FIRE
  If (r And 2) = 0 Then k = k Or Fly3D.K_DIVE
  r = Inp(&HFEFE)                          ' Caps Z X C V
  If (r And 4) = 0 Then k = k Or Fly3D.K_CLIMB
  If (r And 16) = 0 Then k = k Or Fly3D.K_SLOWER
  r = Inp(&H7FFE)                          ' Space Sym M N B
  If (r And 1) = 0 Then k = k Or Fly3D.K_FASTER
  If (r And 4) = 0 Then k = k Or Fly3D.K_ROLLR
  If (r And 8) = 0 Then k = k Or Fly3D.K_ROLLL
  r = Inp(&HBFFE)                          ' Enter L K J H
  If (r And 1) = 0 Then k = k Or K_FIRE
  ReadKeys = k
End Function

' Sync: wait for the frame (3 frames a picture at most 16.7 a second), show the picture; dt: the
' 50ths gone
Sub Sync()
  E3.Poll
  Do While E3.vbl - vflip < 3
    E3.WaitWrap
  Loop
  Frame
  E3.Poll
  E3.Flip
  dt = E3.vbl - vflip
  vflip = E3.vbl
  If dt > 6 Then dt = 6
  frames = frames + 1
End Sub

files.text:
' E3 - POLY's 3D engine, in Z80: filled, shaded polygons on Layer 2 (256 x 192, 256 colours, two
' buffers), objects turned and moved by a camera, cut to the view, hidden faces removed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' The screen: Layer 2 has two buffers, 16K banks 12-14 and 15-17 (pages 24-29, 30-35). One is shown
' (NextReg #12) while the other is drawn: Begin clears it (the zxnDMA filling it 16K at a time), Flip
' shows it. Drawing maps the buffer 64 rows at a time into MMU slots 6 and 7 (#C000-#FFFF) and puts
' slots 6 and 7 back (the data bank's pages, dpage) when it's done.
'
' The camera: cm(0-8), its right, up and forward in the world (s1.14: 16384 is 1), and cp, where it
' is (24.8 bits each way). The view: x right, y up, z ahead; the screen x = 128 + x * 128 / z,
' y = 96 - y * 128 / z (90 degrees across).
'
' An object: a model (E3Data: int8 vertices, convex faces with their normals), where it is (op,
' world units), how it's turned (oa about y, then ob about x: 256 to the turn) and its size (osc:
' a model unit is 2^osc world units, osc 0-6).
' ObjPrep says where it is in the view (oc) and whether it's seen (ovis); ObjDraw draws it: its
' faces turned away are left out (convex), the rest shaded by the sun (sun, s1.14 in the world) in
' 31 steps (16 shades and the 15 between, dithered), cut to the view where they cross its edges.
' Objects are drawn far to near (the caller sorts them by oc(2)).
'
' A polygon (2D): Poly n, c fills pvx(0..n-1), pvy(0..n-1) (clockwise on the screen; any size: it's
' cut to the screen). Each row's span is filled by pushing two pixels at a time with the stack (2
' pixels in 11 T). NTC runs with interrupts off.
'
' The Z80 lives in Lib (one block: its labels are fn_e3_lib_...): the multiplies, the polygon
' filler, the projection, the 3D clipper and the object pipeline. The Subs BASIC calls are thin.
Option Explicit

Public pvx(47) As Integer, pvy(47) As Integer   ' a polygon's screen vertices
Public cm(8) As Integer                          ' the camera: right, up, forward (s1.14)
Public cp(5) As Integer                          ' the camera's position: 3 x 32 bits (24.8)
Public sun(2) As Integer                         ' the sun's direction in the world (s1.14)
Public op(2) As Integer, oa As Integer, ob As Integer   ' an object: position, turned by oa (about y), ob (about x)
Public omod As Integer, osc As Integer, orad As Integer
Public oc(2) As Integer, ovis As Integer         ' ObjPrep: the object in the view, seen (0, 1, 2)
Public pn As Integer, pc As Integer              ' Fill: the vertices, the colours (low: even pixels)
Public obj(255) As Integer, nobj As Integer      ' the scene: 32 objects of 8 words (Scene; the build sets the size)   ' @objtab   ' <--- CHANGED (was 64: room for the framework)
Public nstar As Integer                          ' how many stars (Stars: E3Data's, up to NStars)
Public ppos(2) As Integer, prad As Integer, pcol As Integer   ' the planet: middle, radius (/ 256), ramp
Public palt As Integer                           ' Planet: the height over it (world units, to 32767)
Public aimp(2) As Integer, aimv(2) As Integer, aimk As Integer   ' Aim: a point (/ 256), in the view
Public pup(2) As Integer                         ' Planet: up (away from its middle) in the view (s1.14)
Public txs As Integer                            ' text's size: 1, 2 or 3 times (Char, Text)
Public scene0 As Integer                         ' Scene draws objects scene0 .. nobj - 1
Public vhook As Integer                          ' (NEW) called (Z80, keeping every register) each frame vpoll sees go by: the sound's tick
Public uto As Integer                            ' (NEW) 1: Text, Num and Char draw on the ULA's screen (the HUD over the picture)
Public uca As Integer                            ' <--- NEW 1: UClr clears the cells' attributes too (a paper backing gone: see-through)
Public stymax As Integer                         ' Stars: none on row stymax or under (192: all)
Public scache As Integer                         ' Scene: 1 = take the places ViewAll found (it's just been called)
Public lodb As Integer                           ' (NEW) Scene: the far model down to 128 / 2^lodb pixels across, then a blob (2: 4 pixels, Init's; 1: 8)   ' <--- NEW
Public vwx(31) As Integer, vwy(31) As Integer, vwz(31) As Integer   ' ViewAll: each object in the view   ' @objarr   ' <--- CHANGED (was 64)
Public wq(11) As Integer                         ' Quad3: 4 corners in the world (x, y, z each)
Public rline As Integer                          ' Poll: the raster line it saw
Public vbl As Integer                            ' frames gone by (the raster's wraps, counted by Poll and the drawing)
Private back As Integer, front As Integer, sps As Integer, six As Integer
Private pgw As Integer
Private suc(2) As Integer                        ' the sun in the view
Private od(2) As Integer                         ' the object from the camera (world)
Private ccl(8) As Integer                        ' C's columns
Private oe(2) As Integer, osn(2) As Integer      ' the camera and the sun in the model
Private ov(35) As Integer                       ' the vertices in the view (64 x x, y, z)   ' @verts   ' <--- CHANGED (the build sizes these: E3Data's MaxV, MaxFV)
Private osx(11) As Integer, osy(11) As Integer   ' and on the screen   ' @verts   ' <--- CHANGED
Private cla(29) As Integer, clb(29) As Integer ' the clipper's lists (48 x x, y, z)   ' @verts   ' <--- CHANGED
Private cn As Integer, cmask As Integer
Private ta As Integer

' Init: Layer 2 on, its palette (E3Data's ramps), both buffers cleared, buffer 12 shown, the
' camera at 0, 0, 0 facing +z
Public Sub Init()
  back = 15 : front = 12
  lodb = 2                                                                      ' <--- NEW
  Nx.Reg &H12, front
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0                         ' 256 x 192
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 1 : Nx.Reg &H18, 254 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191   ' (columns 0 and 255 hidden: polygons are cut to 1..255)
  Nx.Reg &H14, &HE3                      ' (nothing see-through but colour #E3's)
  Nx.Reg &H15, &H14                      ' the ULA over Layer 2 (ULS), the sprites off
  Out &H123B, 2
  ' (NEW) nothing else on show, whatever NextZXOS or the loader left: the tilemap off (#6B), the
  ' copper stopped (#62), Layer 2 on and the Timex modes off (#69), Layer 2 and the ULA unscrolled
  ' (#16, #17, #71, #26, #27), black where nothing's on show (#4A), the sprites off (#15 bit 0).
  ' The ULA's screen is on top, wiped see-through: the HUD's text goes there (UText, uto)
  Nx.Reg &H68, 0 : Nx.Reg &H6B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H62, 0 : Nx.Reg &H69, &H80
  Nx.Reg &H26, 0 : Nx.Reg &H27, 0
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0 : Nx.Reg &H71, 0 : Nx.Reg &H4A, 0
  ta =E3Data.REdge() : ta = E3Data.Sines() : ta = E3Data.Font() : ta = E3Data.FontIx() : ta = E3Data.DatAt()   ' (linked: the Z80 reads them)
  Lib
  DataOn
  Palette E3Data.PalAt
  txs = 1
  stymax = 192
  CamReset
  sun(0) = -6000 : sun(1) = 12000 : sun(2) = -9000
  nstar = E3Data.NStars
  Begin 0 : Flip
  Begin 0 : Flip
  UWipe
  For ta = 16 To 31
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalULA, ta, &HE3
  Next
  Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalULA, 0, &HE3
End Sub

' CamReset: the camera at 0, 0, 0, facing +z, up +y
Public Sub CamReset()
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To 8
    cm(k) = 0
  Next
  cm(0) = 16384 : cm(4) = 16384 : cm(8) = 16384
  For k = 0 To 5
    cp(k) = 0
  Next
  CamTurn 0, 0, 0                        ' (squared up: the camera's copies worked out)
End Sub

' DataOn: the data file's bank (Option NexData's first: the projection's table, the palette, the
' stars and the models) into slots 6 and 7 (#C000-#FFFF), where it stays but while drawing - the
' drawing puts it back (dpage) each time it's done with the screen
Private Sub DataOn()
#asm
            ld a, (ntc_nexdata + 1)
            add a, a
            ld (fn_e3_lib_dpage), a
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
#endasm
End Sub

' Palette a: Layer 2's first palette from the 512 bytes at a (9 bit colours)
Private Sub Palette(ByVal a As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, %00010000         ; Layer 2's first palette, auto increment
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #44
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld d, 0                 ; 256 colours, 2 bytes each
pl_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec d
            jr nz, pl_lp
#endasm
End Sub

' Begin c: start a frame in the hidden buffer, filled with colour c (c < 0: left as it is)
Public Sub Begin(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, bg_end
            ld a, l
            ld (bg_src), a
            ld a, ({back})
            add a, a
            ld e, a                 ; the buffer's first page
            ld b, 3
bg_bank:
            ld a, e
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            push bc
            ld hl, bg_prog
            ld bc, 14 * 256 + #6B
            otir
            pop bc
            inc e
            inc e
            djnz bg_bank
            ld a, (fn_e3_lib_dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            jr bg_end
bg_prog:
            db #83, #7D
            dw bg_src
            dw #4000
            db #24, #10, #AD
            dw #C000
            db #82, #CF, #87
bg_src:     db 0
bg_end:
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' Begin2 c1, c2, yb: (NEW) start a frame: rows 0 .. yb - 1 filled with c1, rows yb .. 191 with c2
' (c2 under 0: those rows left as they are - something drawn will cover them all)
' (the zxnDMA does both: the flat ground under the horizon's lowest point costs nothing to fill)
Public Sub Begin2(ByVal c1 As Integer, ByVal c2 As Integer, ByVal yb As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (b2_c1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (b2_c2), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (b2_keep), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (b2_yb), a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld a, ({back})
            add a, a
            ld (b2_pg), a
            xor a                   ; the window's first row
            ld (b2_w), a
b2_win:
            ld a, (b2_pg)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            ld a, (b2_w)            ; rows above yb in this window: n = yb - w (0 .. 64)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (b2_yb)
            sub b
            jr nc, b2_1
            xor a
b2_1:
            cp 64
            jr c, b2_2
            ld a, 64
b2_2:
            ld (b2_n), a
            or a
            jr z, b2_low
            ld h, a                 ; the top part: n x 256 at #C000, c1
            ld l, 0
            ld (b2_len), hl
            ld hl, #C000
            ld (b2_dst), hl
            ld a, (b2_c1)
            ld (b2_src), a
            call b2_dma
b2_low:
            ld a, (b2_keep)
            or a
            jr nz, b2_nx
            ld a, (b2_n)
            cp 64
            jr z, b2_nx
            ld b, a                 ; the bottom part: (64 - n) x 256 at #C000 + n x 256, c2
            ld a, 64
            sub b
            ld h, a
            ld l, 0
            ld (b2_len), hl
            ld a, b
            add a, #C0
            ld h, a
            ld l, 0
            ld (b2_dst), hl
            ld a, (b2_c2)
            ld (b2_src), a
            call b2_dma
b2_nx:
            ld a, (b2_pg)
            add a, 2
            ld (b2_pg), a
            ld a, (b2_w)
            add a, 64
            ld (b2_w), a
            cp 192
            jr c, b2_win
            ld a, (fn_e3_lib_dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            jr b2_end
b2_dma:
            ld hl, b2_prog
            ld bc, 14 * 256 + #6B
            otir
            ret
b2_prog:
            db #83, #7D
            dw b2_src
b2_len:     dw #4000
            db #24, #10, #AD
b2_dst:     dw #C000
            db #82, #CF, #87
b2_src:     db 0
b2_c1:      db 0
b2_c2:      db 0
b2_yb:      db 0
b2_pg:      db 0
b2_w:       db 0
b2_n:       db 0
b2_keep:    db 0
b2_end:
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' Flip: the buffer just drawn shown (call it straight after Frame), the other one to draw next
Public Sub Flip()
  Dim t As Integer
  Nx.Reg &H12, back
  t = front : front = back : back = t
End Sub

' Poly n, c: the convex polygon pvx(0..n-1), pvy(0..n-1) (clockwise on the screen) in colour c
Public Sub Poly(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  pn = n : pc = (c And 255) * 257
  Fill
End Sub

' Fill: the polygon pvx, pvy (pn vertices) in the colours pc (low byte: the even pixels of the even
' rows, high byte: the odd ones; swapped on odd rows - the same twice is a plain colour)
Public Sub Fill()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            call fn_e3_lib_fill

' 6 words: the peak's bearing in the world (x, z: 127 is 1 - far off: it never comes nearer), its
' half width and height in pixels as seen head on, its colours (as pc), its top (0: a point; k: flat,
' w / 2^k each side of the middle). Each one ahead is a triangle (or a flat topped cone) standing
' on row yb + 1, in the order given: draw the far ones first. Its place across is the bearing seen
' by the camera's right and forward; its size shrinks toward the edges as the projection's does
Public Sub Skyline(ByVal tab As Integer, ByVal n As Integer, ByVal yb As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (sk_p), de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (sk_n), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (sk_yb), a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            ld a, (sk_n)
            or a
            jp z, sk_end
sk_lp:
            ld ix, (sk_p)
            ld de, ({cm} + 12)      ; f: how far ahead (bearing . forward; 127 dead ahead)
            ld bc, ({cm} + 16)
            call sk_dot
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp nz, sk_nx            ; (behind)
            ld a, l
            cp 24
            jp c, sk_nx             ; (too far round to the side)
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, fn_e3data_redge_redge_d
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (sk_r), hl           ; R = 65536 / f
            ld de, ({cm} + 0)       ; X: across (bearing . right)
            ld bc, ({cm} + 4)
            call sk_dot
            ld a, h
            ld (sk_sg), a
            bit 7, h
            jr z, sk_xp
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
sk_xp:
            add hl, hl              ; |X| x 128 x R >> 16: the pixels across from the middle
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, (sk_r)
            call fn_e3_lib_umul
            ld a, (sk_sg)
            bit 7, a
            jr z, sk_x2
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
sk_x2:
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            ld (sk_x), hl
            ld a, (ix + 4)          ; the half width and the height, x 127 / f
            call sk_sc
            ld (sk_w), hl
            ld a, (ix + 6)
            call sk_sc
            ld (sk_h), hl
            ld hl, (sk_x)           ; on the screen at all? (x + w >= 0, x - w < 256)
            ld de, (sk_w)
            add hl, de
            ld (sk_rx), hl
            bit 7, h
            jp nz, sk_nx
            ld hl, (sk_x)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sk_lx), hl
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, sk_in
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp nz, sk_nx
sk_in:
            ld a, (sk_yb)           ; the corners: (x - w, yb + 1), the top, (x + w, yb + 1)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            inc hl
            ld (sk_yf), hl
            ld a, (sk_yb)
            ld l, a
            ld de, (sk_h)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sk_yt), hl
            ld hl, (sk_lx)
            ld ({pvx}), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yf)
            ld ({pvy}), hl
            ld a, (ix + 10)         ; flat topped?
            or a
            jr nz, sk_flat
            ld hl, (sk_x)
            ld ({pvx} + 2), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yt)
            ld ({pvy} + 2), hl
            ld hl, (sk_rx)
            ld ({pvx} + 4), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yf)
            ld ({pvy} + 4), hl
            ld a, 3
            jr sk_fill
sk_flat:
            ld b, a
            ld hl, (sk_w)
sk_tw:
            srl h
            rr l
            djnz sk_tw
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (sk_x)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld ({pvx} + 2), hl
            ld hl, (sk_x)
            add hl, de
            ld ({pvx} + 4), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yt)
            ld ({pvy} + 2), hl
            ld ({pvy} + 4), hl
            ld hl, (sk_rx)
            ld ({pvx} + 6), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yf)
            ld ({pvy} + 6), hl
            ld a, 4
sk_fill:
            ld ({pn}), a
            xor a
            ld ({pn} + 1), a
            ld l, (ix + 8)
            ld h, (ix + 9)
            ld ({pc}), hl
            call fn_e3_lib_fill
sk_nx:
            ld hl, (sk_p)
            ld de, 12
            add hl, de
            ld (sk_p), hl
            ld hl, sk_n
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, sk_lp
            jr sk_end
; sk_dot: HL = (bearing x . DE + bearing z . BC) >> 14 (the record at IX)
sk_dot:
            push bc
            ld c, (ix + 0)
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            call fn_e3_lib_m14
            pop de
            push hl
            ld c, (ix + 2)
            ld b, (ix + 3)
            call fn_e3_lib_m14
            pop de
            add hl, de
            ret
; sk_sc: HL = A x 127 x R >> 16
sk_sc:
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, (sk_r)
            jp fn_e3_lib_umul
sk_p:       dw 0
sk_n:       db 0
sk_yb:      db 0
sk_sg:      db 0
sk_r:       dw 0
sk_x:       dw 0
sk_w:       dw 0
sk_h:       dw 0
sk_lx:      dw 0
sk_rx:      dw 0
sk_yf:      dw 0
sk_yt:      dw 0
sk_end:
            pop iy
            ld ix, ({six})
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

#asm
            pop hl

            ld a, (hl)

            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (hp_uz), de
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({pc}), de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)

            ld (hp_xy + 14), a
            ld (hp_yb), a
            ld b, a
            ld a, 96

            ld (hp_q + 5), a
            ld (hp_q + 7), a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld hl, (hp_uz)          ; uz x 128
            ld b, 7
hp_z7:
            add hl, hl
            djnz hp_z7
            ld (hp_uz), hl
            ld ix, hp_q             ; the corners' f
            ld iy, hp_f
            ld b, 4

            ld d, (ix + 0)

            ld e, a
            call fn_e3_lib_mul8s
            push de
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            ld a, (hp_uy)
            ld e, a
            call fn_e3_lib_mul8s
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, (hp_uz)
            add hl, de
            ld (iy + 0), l
            ld (iy + 1), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc iy
            inc iy
            pop bc
            djnz hp_fl
            xor a                   ; round the corners, cut where f changes sign
            ld (hp_n), a
            ld (hp_j), a
hp_cl:
            ld a, (hp_j)
            call hp_getf            ; HL = f(j)
            ld (hp_a), hl
            ld a, (hp_j)
            inc a
            and 3
            call hp_getf
            ld (hp_b), hl
            ld a, (hp_a + 1)        ; f(j) < 0: the corner's in
            bit 7, a
            jr z, hp_c1
            ld a, (hp_j)
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, hp_xy
            add hl, de
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            call hp_put
hp_c1:
            ld a, (hp_a + 1)        ; the signs differ: where the edge crosses
            ld b, a
            ld a, (hp_b + 1)
            xor b
            jp p, hp_c2
            ld hl, (hp_a)
            bit 7, h
            call nz, hp_neg
            push hl
            ld hl, (hp_b)
            bit 7, h
            call nz, hp_neg
            pop de
            add hl, de              ; |fa| + |fb|
            ex de, hl               ; HL = |fa|, DE = the sum
            call fn_e3_lib_udivf    ; t (x 65536)
            ld (hp_t), hl
            ld a, (hp_j)
            or a
            jr nz, hp_e1
            ld de, 254              ; top: x = 1 + 254 t, y 0
            call hp_kt
            inc hl
            ex de, hl
            ld bc, 0
            jr hp_ep
hp_e1:
            cp 1
            jr nz, hp_e2
            ld a, (hp_yb)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            call hp_kt
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, 255
            jr hp_ep
hp_e2:
            cp 2
            jr nz, hp_e3
            ld de, 254              ; bottom: x = 255 - 254 t, y 192
            call hp_kt
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 255
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hp_yb)
            ld c, a
            ld b, 0
            jr hp_ep
hp_e3:
            ld a, (hp_yb)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            call hp_kt
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hp_yb)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, 1
hp_ep:
            call hp_put
hp_c2:
            ld a, (hp_j)
            inc a
            ld (hp_j), a
            cp 4
            jp c, hp_cl
            ld a, (hp_n)
            cp 3
            jr c, hp_end
            ld ({pn}), a
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            call fn_e3_lib_fill
            pop iy
            ld ix, ({six})
            jr hp_end
hp_getf:    ; HL = f(A)
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, hp_f
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ret
hp_neg:
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret
hp_kt:      ; HL = DE x t / 65536
            ld bc, (hp_t)
            call fn_e3_lib_umul
            ret
hp_put:     ; a point: x DE, y BC
            ld a, (hp_n)
            add a, a
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            push hl
            push bc
            ld bc, {pvx}

            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            pop bc
            pop hl
            ld de, {pvy}
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), b
            ld hl, hp_n
            inc (hl)
            ret
hp_q:       db -127, 96, 127, 96, 127, -96, -127, -96
hp_xy:      dw 1, 0, 255, 0, 255, 192, 1, 192
hp_f:       ds 8
hp_ux:      db 0
hp_uy:      db 0
hp_uz:      dw 0
hp_yb:      db 192
hp_n:       db 0
hp_j:       db 0
hp_a:       dw 0
hp_b:       dw 0
hp_t:       dw 0
hp_end:

' two smaller discs (c1, then c2) shrunk toward the edge nearest the sun - far cheaper than Planet
' for a moon well off (no horizon, no height: palt isn't set)
Public Sub Moon(ByVal c0 As Integer, ByVal c1 As Integer, ByVal c2 As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl

            ld d, (hl)
            ld (mn_c0), de

            inc hl

            pop hl

            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)

            ld hl, ({ppos})

            ld hl, ({aimv} + 4)     ; ahead (z 64 on)?
            bit 7, h
            jp nz, mn_end
            ld de, 64
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp c, mn_end
            ld hl, ({aimv} + 4)     ; (the middle more than 2z off to a side: left out)
            add hl, hl
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, ({aimv})
            bit 7, h
            call nz, mn_ng
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp nc, mn_end
            ld hl, ({aimv} + 2)
            bit 7, h
            call nz, mn_ng
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp nc, mn_end
            ld hl, {aimv}
            call fn_e3_lib_len3
            ld (mn_len), hl
            ld hl, ({aimv})         ; its middle on the screen
            ld de, ({aimv} + 2)
            ld bc, ({aimv} + 4)
            call fn_e3_lib_proj
            ld (mn_x), hl
            ld (mn_y), de
            ld hl, ({prad})         ; its radius in the same units: prad x 256 >> aimk
            ld a, ({aimk})
            sub 8
            jr c, mn_sl
            jr z, mn_r0
            ld b, a
mn_sr:
            srl h
            rr l
            djnz mn_sr
            jr mn_r0
mn_sl:
            neg
            ld b, a
mn_sl1:
            add hl, hl
            jp c, mn_end            ; (far too big)
            djnz mn_sl1
mn_r0:
            ld de, 0                ; on the screen: proj(R, 0, the length) - 128

            call fn_e3_lib_proj
            ld de, -128
            add hl, de
            bit 7, h
            jp nz, mn_end
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr z, mn_r1
            ld hl, 255
mn_r1:
            ld a, l
            or a
            jp z, mn_end
            ld (mn_r), a
            ld hl, (mn_c0)          ; the dark disc
            ld ({pc}), hl
            ld hl, (mn_x)
            ld de, (mn_y)
            ld a, (mn_r)
            call mn_disc
            ld bc, ({suc})          ; the edge toward the sun: S = the middle + (sun x, -sun y) r
            ld a, (mn_r)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            call fn_e3_lib_m14
            ld de, (mn_x)
            add hl, de
            ld (mn_sx), hl

            ld de, (mn_sy)

            add hl, de

            ld a, (mn_dr)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld a, c

            ld (ix + 97), h

            inc ix

            ld b, a
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            ld hl, 0
mn_q1:
            add hl, de
            djnz mn_q1
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ret
mn_ng:
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret

mn_c1:      dw 0
mn_c2:      dw 0
mn_len:     dw 0
mn_x:       dw 0
mn_y:       dw 0

' (E3Data's ModelTab: its near and far models), size osc, radius rad (world units), turning by da,
' db (256 to the turn) each frame, a dot of colour dc when tiny
Public Sub ObjSet(ByVal k As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal kind As Integer, ByVal sc As Integer, ByVal rad As Integer, ByVal da As Integer, ByVal db As Integer, ByVal dc As Integer)
  Dim p As Integer
  p = k * 8
  obj(p) = x : obj(p + 1) = y : obj(p + 2) = z
  obj(p + 3) = 0
  obj(p + 4) = (da And 255) + (db And 255) * 256
  obj(p + 5) = kind + sc * 256
  obj(p + 6) = rad
  obj(p + 7) = dc
End Sub

' ObjCull: as ObjPrep, by the camera to 1/128 (for sorting and leaving out: cheap)
Public Sub ObjCull()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            call fn_e3_lib_oprep8
            pop iy
            ld ix, ({six})
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' ObjPrep: the object op (its radius orad, world units, under 4000) in the view: oc, and ovis 0 (not

Public Sub ObjPrep()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            call fn_e3_lib_oprep
            pop iy
            ld ix, ({six})
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' ObjDraw: the object op, oa, ob, omod, osc (orad) drawn

#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp

            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy

            pop iy

' Lib: the Z80 the rest calls (called once by Init so it's linked: it does nothing)
Private Sub Lib()
#asm
            ret
dpage:      db 10                   ; the data's first page (DataOn): slots 6 and 7 between drawings
; ============================================================================ the multiplies
; umul: BC x DE (unsigned) -> HL:DE
umul:
            ld a, e
            ld l, d                 ; (d0 kept in L)
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; c * e0
            push de
            ld d, b
            ld e, a
            mul d, e                ; b * e0
            ld a, l
            ld h, d
            ld l, e
            ld d, c
            ld e, a
            mul d, e                ; c * d0
            add hl, de              ; the middle (17 bits)
            ld c, 0
            rl c
            ld d, b
            ld e, a
            mul d, e                ; b * d0
            ld a, h
            ld b, l
            ex de, hl               ; HL = b * d0
            ld e, a
            ld d, c
            add hl, de              ; + the middle's top
            pop de                  ; c * e0
            ld a, d
            add a, b                ; + the middle's bottom
            ld d, a
            ret nc
            inc hl
            ret
; smul: BC (signed) x DE (unsigned) -> HL:DE (signed)
smul:
            bit 7, b
            jp z, umul
            push de
            call umul
            ex (sp), hl
            ex de, hl
            ex (sp), hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            pop de
            ret
; ssmul: BC x DE (both signed) -> HL:DE
ssmul:
            push bc
            push de
            call umul
            ld (ss_lo), de
            pop de
            pop bc
            bit 7, b
            jr z, ss_1
            or a
            sbc hl, de
ss_1:
            bit 7, d
            jr z, ss_2
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
ss_2:
            ld de, (ss_lo)
            ret
ss_lo:      dw 0
; m14: (BC x DE) >> 14 -> HL (s1.14 products)
m14:
            call ssmul
            ld a, d
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl
            ret
; m816: A (signed) x DE (signed) -> A:HL (24 bits signed)
m816:
            ld c, a
            xor d
            ld (m8_sg), a
            ld a, c
            or a
            jp p, m8_1
            neg
m8_1:
            ld c, a                 ; |a|
            bit 7, d
            jr z, m8_2
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a                 ; |de|
m8_2:
            ld a, d
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |a| * e
            ld h, d
            ld l, e
            ld e, a
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |a| * d
            ld a, e
            add a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, d
            adc a, 0
            ld c, a
            ld a, (m8_sg)
            or a
            ld a, c
            ret p
            ld c, a
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, c
            ret
m8_sg:      db 0
; udivf: HL / DE (unsigned, HL < DE) -> HL = HL * 65536 / DE (HL >= DE: 65535)
udivf:
            push hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            pop hl
            jr c, ud_go
            ld hl, 65535
            ret
ud_go:
            ld bc, 0
            ld a, 16
ud_lp:
            add hl, hl
            jr c, ud_sub
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jr nc, ud_one
            add hl, de
            sla c
            rl b
            dec a
            jr nz, ud_lp
            jr ud_end
ud_sub:
            or a
            sbc hl, de
ud_one:
            scf
            rl c
            rl b
            dec a
            jr nz, ud_lp
ud_end:
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            ret
; absh: HL = |HL|
absh:
            bit 7, h
            ret z
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret
; mrow: (IX: 3 words) . (IY: 3 words) >> 14 -> HL (32 bit sum)
mrow:
            ld c, (ix + 0)
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld e, (iy + 0)
            ld d, (iy + 1)
            call ssmul
            ld (mr_l), de
            ld (mr_h), hl
            ld c, (ix + 2)
            ld b, (ix + 3)
            ld e, (iy + 2)
            ld d, (iy + 3)
            call ssmul
            call mr_add
            ld c, (ix + 4)
            ld b, (ix + 5)
            ld e, (iy + 4)
            ld d, (iy + 5)
            call ssmul
            call mr_add
            ld hl, (mr_h)
            ld a, (mr_l + 1)
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl
            ret
mr_add:
            push hl
            ld hl, (mr_l)
            add hl, de
            ld (mr_l), hl
            pop de
            ld hl, (mr_h)
            adc hl, de
            ld (mr_h), hl
            ret
mr_l:       dw 0
mr_h:       dw 0
; ============================================================================ the camera
; rotp: rows IX (A) and IY (B) of the camera turned by HL / 16384 radians: A = A c + B s,
; B = B c - A s (s = a, c = 1 - a^2 / 2)
rotp:
            ld a, h
            or l
            ret z
            ld (rp_s), hl
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            call ssmul              ; a^2 (s2.28) -> a^2 / 2 in s1.14 is HL:DE >> 15
            ld a, d
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl              ; HL = a^2 >> 15
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 16384
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (rp_c), hl
            ld b, 3
rp_lp:
            push bc
            ld c, (ix + 0)          ; A c
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld de, (rp_c)
            call m14
            ld (rp_t), hl
            ld c, (iy + 0)          ; + B s
            ld b, (iy + 1)
            ld de, (rp_s)
            call m14
            ld de, (rp_t)
            add hl, de
            ld (rp_na), hl
            ld c, (iy + 0)          ; B c
            ld b, (iy + 1)
            ld de, (rp_c)
            call m14
            ld (rp_t), hl
            ld c, (ix + 0)          ; - A s
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld de, (rp_s)
            call m14
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (rp_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (iy + 0), l
            ld (iy + 1), h
            ld hl, (rp_na)
            ld (ix + 0), l
            ld (ix + 1), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc iy
            inc iy
            pop bc
            djnz rp_lp
            ret
rp_s:       dw 0
rp_c:       dw 0
rp_t:       dw 0
rp_na:      dw 0
; renorm: F unit length, U square to F and unit, R = U x F; then the sun in the view
renorm:
            ld ix, {cm} + 12
            call rn_unit
            ld ix, {cm} + 6         ; U -= (U . F) F
            ld iy, {cm} + 12
            call mrow
            ld (rn_d), hl
            ld b, 3
rn_lp:
            push bc
            ld c, (iy + 0)
            ld b, (iy + 1)
            ld de, (rn_d)
            call m14
            ex de, hl
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (ix + 0), l
            ld (ix + 1), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc iy
            inc iy
            pop bc
            djnz rn_lp
            ld ix, {cm} + 6
            call rn_unit
            ; R = U x F: Rx = Uy Fz - Uz Fy, Ry = Uz Fx - Ux Fz, Rz = Ux Fy - Uy Fx
            ld hl, {cm} + 8
            ld de, {cm} + 16
            ld bc, {cm} + 10
            ld ix, {cm} + 14
            call rn_cross
            ld ({cm}), hl
            ld hl, {cm} + 10
            ld de, {cm} + 12
            ld bc, {cm} + 6
            ld ix, {cm} + 16
            call rn_cross
            ld ({cm} + 2), hl
            ld hl, {cm} + 6
            ld de, {cm} + 14
            ld bc, {cm} + 8
            ld ix, {cm} + 12
            call rn_cross
            ld ({cm} + 4), hl
sunv:
            ld iy, {sun}            ; the sun in the view
            ld ix, {cm}
            call mrow
            ld ({suc}), hl
            ld ix, {cm} + 6
            call mrow
            ld ({suc} + 2), hl
            ld ix, {cm} + 12
            call mrow
            ld ({suc} + 4), hl
            ld hl, {cm}             ; the camera >> k (k 0..6, rounded): cms + 18 k
            ld de, cms
            ld bc, 18
            ldir
            ld ix, cms
            ld b, 6 * 9
cs_lp:
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            sra h
            rr l
            ld de, 0
            adc hl, de              ; (rounded: the bit shifted out added back)
            ld (ix + 18), l
            ld (ix + 19), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            djnz cs_lp
            ld hl, {cm}             ; 8 bit copies (>> 7, to +-127): the camera, the sun in the view
            ld de, cm8
            ld b, 9
s8_lp:
            call s8_one
            djnz s8_lp
            ld hl, {suc}
            ld de, suc8
            ld b, 3
s8_l2:
            call s8_one
            djnz s8_l2
            ld hl, {sun}
            ld de, sunw8
            ld b, 3
s8_l3:
            call s8_one
            djnz s8_l3
            ret
s8_one:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            push de
            ld de, 64
            add hl, de
            pop de
            add hl, hl
            ld a, h
            jr c, s8_neg
            cp 128
            jr c, s8_st
            ld a, 127
            jr s8_st
s8_neg:
            cp 129
            jr nc, s8_st
            ld a, 129
s8_st:
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            inc hl
            ret
rn_d:       dw 0
; rn_cross: (HL) x (DE) - (BC) x (IX) (words; s1.14 products) -> HL
rn_cross:
            ld (rc_b), bc
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld b, d
            ld c, e
            ex de, hl
            call m14
            ld (rc_t), hl
            ld hl, (rc_b)
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            ld e, (ix + 0)
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            call m14
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (rc_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret
rc_b:       dw 0
rc_t:       dw 0
; rn_unit: the vector at IX (3 words, near unit length) scaled by (3 - |v|^2) / 2
rn_unit:
            push ix
            pop iy
            call mrow               ; |v|^2 (s1.14)
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 49152
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            srl h
            rr l                    ; (3 - k) / 2
            ld (rn_k), hl
            ld b, 3
ru_lp:
            push bc
            ld c, (ix + 0)
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld de, (rn_k)
            call m14
            ld (ix + 0), l
            ld (ix + 1), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            pop bc
            djnz ru_lp
            ret
rn_k:       dw 0
; ============================================================================ the polygon filler
; fill: pvx, pvy (pn vertices, clockwise on the screen) in the colours pc
fill:
            ld a, ({pn})
            cp 3
            ret c
            push iy
            push ix
            ld (fl_ssp), sp
            ; all on the screen (x 1..255, y 0..192)? Then the fast way, the points as bytes
            cp 49
            jp nc, fl_exit
            ld b, a
            ld hl, {pvx}
            ld de, {pvy}
            ld ix, ff_v
            ld c, 0
            ld a, 255
            ld (ff_ytop), a
            xor a
            ld (ff_ybot), a
fs_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            or a
            jp z, fl_slow           ; x = 0
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            or a
            jp nz, fl_slow          ; x < 0 or over 255
            ld a, (de)
            inc de
            ld (ix + 1), a
            cp 193
            jp nc, fl_slow
            ld a, (de)
            inc de
            or a
            jp nz, fl_slow          ; y < 0 or over 192
            ld a, (ix + 1)          ; the top (the first), the bottom
            push hl
            ld hl, ff_ytop
            cp (hl)
            jr nc, fs_1
            ld (hl), a
            ld a, c
            ld (ff_top), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
fs_1:
            ld hl, ff_ybot
            cp (hl)
            jr c, fs_2
            ld (hl), a
fs_2:
            pop hl
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc c
            djnz fs_lp
            jp ff
fl_exit:
            ld sp, (fl_ssp)
            ld a, (fn_e3_lib_dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            pop ix
            pop iy
            ret
fl_slow:
            ; not all on the screen: the sides crossed (x < 1, x > 255, y < 0, y > 192); all off one
            ; side: nothing; else cut to them into ff_v, then the fast way
            ld a, ({pn})
            cp 49
            jp nc, fl_exit
            ld b, a
            ld hl, {pvx}
            ld de, {pvy}
            ld c, 0
            ld a, #0F
            ld (c2_and), a
fo_lp:
            push bc
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld l, 0
            bit 7, b
            jr nz, fo_x0
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, fo_x1
            ld a, c
            or a
            jr nz, fo_y
fo_x0:
            set 0, l
            jr fo_y
fo_x1:
            set 1, l
fo_y:
            ld a, (de)
            ld c, a
            inc de
            ld a, (de)
            inc de
            ld b, a
            bit 7, b
            jr nz, fo_y0
            or a
            jr nz, fo_y1
            ld a, c
            cp 193
            jr c, fo_ok
fo_y1:
            set 3, l
            jr fo_ok
fo_y0:
            set 2, l
fo_ok:
            ld a, (c2_and)
            and l
            ld (c2_and), a
            ld a, l
            pop hl
            pop bc
            or c
            ld c, a
            djnz fo_lp
            ld a, (c2_and)
            or a
            jp nz, fl_exit
            ld a, c
            ld (c2_mask), a
            call clip2
            ld a, ({pn})
            cp 3
            jp c, fl_exit
            jp ff
; ---- the fast way: both sides stepped in registers (8.8), no tables. The left side: HL' x,
; DE' its step; the right: IX x (the last pixel), BC' its step; IYH the row's address (high),
; IYL the rows to go; DE the colours
ff:
            call vpoll
            ld a, (ff_ytop)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_ybot)
            cp b
            jp z, fl_exit           ; (flat)
            ld a, b
            ld (ff_y), a
            ld a, ({pn})            ; the points' ends (for going round them)
            add a, a
            sub 2
            ld (ff_lend), a         ; the last one's (low byte)
            add a, 2
            ld (ff_rend), a         ; one past it
            ld a, (ff_top)
            add a, a
            ld l, a
            ld h, ffpage >> 8
            ld (ff_pl), hl
            ld (ff_pr), hl
            ld hl, ff_advl          ; (the events: going round the points)
            ld (ff_cl + 1), hl
            ld hl, ff_advr
            ld (ff_cr + 1), hl
            call ff_advl
            call ff_advr
ff_run:
            ld hl, ({pc})           ; the colours: swapped on odd rows
            ld a, (ff_y)
            rra
            jr nc, ff_c0
            ld a, h
            ld h, l
            ld l, a
ff_c0:
            ld (ff_de), hl
            ld a, 255
            ld (ff_w), a
ff_chunk:
            ld a, (ff_y)            ; n = min(the left's end, the right's, the window's) - y
            or 63
            inc a
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_yl)
            cp b
            jr nc, ff_n1
            ld b, a
ff_n1:
            ld a, (ff_yr)
            cp b
            jr nc, ff_n2
            ld b, a
ff_n2:
            ld a, (ff_y)
            ld c, a
            ld a, b
            sub c
            jr z, ff_ev
            ld (ff_n), a
            ld iyl, a
            ld a, c                 ; the window
            and #C0
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_w)
            cp b
            jr z, ff_wok
            ld a, b
            ld (ff_w), a
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 6
            ld c, a
            ld a, ({back})
            add a, a
            add a, c
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
ff_wok:
            ld a, (ff_y)
            and 63
            or #C0
            ld iyh, a
            ld de, (ff_de)
            jp fr_row
ff_after:
            ld sp, (fl_ssp)
            ld (ff_de), de
            ld a, (ff_n)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_y)
            add a, b
            ld (ff_y), a
ff_ev:
            ld a, (ff_y)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_ybot)
            cp b
            jp z, fl_exit
            jp c, fl_exit
            ld a, (ff_yl)
            cp b
ff_cl:
            call z, ff_advl
            ld a, (ff_y)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_yr)
            cp b
ff_cr:
            call z, ff_advr
            jp ff_chunk
; ff_advl, ff_advr: a side's next edge going down (left: back round the points, right: on). The
; points are ff_v's (x, y) bytes; ff_pl, ff_pr point at each side's current one
ff_advl:
            ld a, (ff_ybot)         ; (none found: to the bottom)
            ld (ff_yl), a
            ld a, ({pn})
            ld b, a                 ; (a guard)
            ld hl, (ff_pl)
al_lp:
            ld a, l
            or a
            jr nz, al_1
            ld a, (ff_lend)
            jr al_2
al_1:
            sub 2
al_2:
            ld e, a
            ld d, h
            inc l
            inc e
            ld a, (de)
            sub (hl)
            ld c, a
            dec l                   ; (inc and dec keep the carry, not the zero)
            dec e
            ret c                   ; (going up: none)
            ld a, c
            or a
            jr z, al_flat
            ld (ff_pl), de
            xor a
            call edge88
            ld (ff_yl), a
            push hl
            push bc
            exx
            pop de
            pop hl
            exx
            ret
al_flat:
            ex de, hl
            djnz al_lp
            ret
ff_advr:
            ld a, (ff_ybot)
            ld (ff_yr), a
            ld a, ({pn})
            ld b, a
            ld hl, (ff_pr)
ar_lp:
            ld a, (ff_rend)
            ld e, a
            ld a, l
            add a, 2
            cp e
            jr nz, ar_1
            xor a
ar_1:
            ld e, a
            ld d, h
            inc l
            inc e
            ld a, (de)
            sub (hl)
            ld c, a
            dec l
            dec e
            ret c
            ld a, c
            or a
            jr z, ar_flat
            ld (ff_pr), de
            ld a, 1
            call edge88
            ld (ff_yr), a
            push hl
            pop ix
            push bc
            exx
            pop bc
            exx
            ret
ar_flat:
            ex de, hl
            djnz ar_lp
            ret
; edge88: the edge from point (HL) to point (DE) (both x, y; going down); A = 1: the right side ->
; HL = x (8.8, from a pixel's middle; the right side's - 1: its last pixel), BC = the step (mod
; 65536: x stays on the screen), A = the end's y
edge88:
            ld (e8_rt), a
            ld a, (de)              ; dx = xb - xa: |dx| in C, its sign in B
            sub (hl)
            ld b, 0
            jr nc, e8_p
            neg
            dec b
e8_p:
            ld c, a
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (e8_xa), a
            inc l
            inc e
            ld a, (de)
            ld (e8_yb), a
            sub (hl)                ; dy
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, fn_e3data_redge_redge_d
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; R = 65536 / dy
            ld a, d
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |dx| R low
            ld l, d

            exx
            ld a, h                 ; x0
            add hl, de
            db #08                  ; ex af, af
            ld a, ixh               ; x1
            add ix, bc
            exx
            ld b, a
            db #08
            ld c, a
            ld a, iyh
            ld h, a

            jr z, fr_a

            inc ix

; ============================================================================ the projection
; proj: HL = x, DE = y, BC = z (> 0) in the view, |x| and |y| at most 2z (about) -> HL = the screen
; x, DE = the screen y. z = n 2^k (n 256..4095; x, y shifted by k too), R = 2^24 / n; then
; x R / 2^17 by three multiplies (the low bytes' product left out: under half a pixel)
proj:
            ld a, b
            and #F0
            jr z, pj_lo
pj_rs:
            srl b                   ; z over 4095: all >> 1
            rr c
            sra h
            rr l
            sra d
            rr e
            ld a, b
            and #F0
            jr nz, pj_rs
            jr pj_n
pj_lo:
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, pj_n
            or c                    ; (z 0: as 1, not forever)
            jr nz, pj_ls
            inc c
pj_ls:
            sla c                   ; z under 256: all << 1
            rl b
            add hl, hl
            sla e
            rl d
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr z, pj_ls
pj_n:
            ld (pj_y), de
            push hl
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            dec h
            add hl, hl
            ld de, d_rproj
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (pj_rl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (pj_rh), a
            pop hl
            call pj_m
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            push hl
            ld hl, (pj_y)
            call pj_m
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 96
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ret
pj_m:                               ; HL (signed) x R >> 17 -> HL
            ld a, h
            ld (pj_sg), a
            bit 7, h
            jr z, pm_1
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
pm_1:
            ld b, h                 ; xh
            ld c, l                 ; xl
            ld a, (pj_rl)
            ld e, a
            ld d, b
            mul d, e                ; xh rl
            push de
            ld a, (pj_rh)
            ld e, a
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; xl rh
            pop hl
            add hl, de              ; m (carry: its bit 16)
            ld l, h
            ld h, 0
            rl h                    ; m >> 8
            ld a, (pj_rh)
            ld e, a
            ld d, b
            mul d, e                ; xh rh
            add hl, de
            srl h                   ; >> 1
            rr l
            ld a, (pj_sg)
            or a
            ret p
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret
pj_y:       dw 0
pj_rl:      db 0
pj_rh:      db 0
pj_sg:      db 0
; vcode: HL = x, DE = y, BC = z in the view (under 16384 each way) -> A: bit 0 z < 16 (the near
; plane), bit 1 x > 4z, bit 2 -x > 4z, bit 3 y > 4z, bit 4 -y > 4z (a wide guard band: the 2D
; clipper cuts the rest)
vcode:
            ld (vc_x), hl
            ld (vc_y), de
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            ld de, -16
            add hl, de
            ld a, h
            rlca
            and 1
            ld (vc_c), a
            ld hl, (vc_x)
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ex de, hl
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp p, vc_1
            ld a, (vc_c)
            or 2
            ld (vc_c), a
vc_1:
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            adc hl, de
            jp p, vc_2
            ld a, (vc_c)
            or 4
            ld (vc_c), a
vc_2:
            ld hl, (vc_y)
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ex de, hl
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp p, vc_3
            ld a, (vc_c)
            or 8
            ld (vc_c), a
vc_3:
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            adc hl, de
            jp p, vc_4
            ld a, (vc_c)
            or 16
            ld (vc_c), a
vc_4:
            ld a, (vc_c)
            ret
vc_x:       dw 0
vc_y:       dw 0
vc_c:       db 0
